answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a stake that only unlocks after a slow, verifiable work history — like a glacier moving: fake identities cannot fake time. Reputation should accrue gradually from completed, attested tasks, and new agents start with a small saffron-coloured trust budget that grows only through real counterparties vouching for them. Any identity that appears overnight with a perfect record is treated as a fable, not a fact, until its history is independently verified.
